properties.segment: Confirmed UA481 6:03 PM PDT departure / 10:36 PM SJC arrival · UA1317 Sep 7 6:40 AM PDT departure

properties.name: Pre-private USFS dry camp
properties.notes: Shasta County parcel screen: USFS APN 022-170-001. Candidate is about 250 ft from the PCT, 626 ft from the mapped MVUM road, 0.363 mi from mapped private property, and 5.0% mean sampled slope. Confirm vegetation, hazards, durable surface, and three-person capacity on foot.

properties.name: Bartle Gap planned pickup / re-entry
properties.segment: 12.6 mi day-pack-supported continuous traverse; extract at the agreed field pin and return to the exact PCTA crossing before Day 4.
properties.notes: This is a required itinerary handoff, not a campsite or a casual bailout: immediate Day 3 pickup, legal off-corridor overnight, then Day 4 return to this exact pin. The driver, vehicle route, gate status, pickup window, and no-contact fallback must be confirmed before the trip.

properties.name: Ash Camp pickup
properties.segment: 3.9 mi to the Ash Camp pickup. Confirm FS Road 38N11 before Mikaela drives it.

services: Access to STAGE bus, Amtrak Coast Starlight, and Mt. Shasta Taxi
towns.notes: Prime rest day between Castle Crags and Mt. Shasta. Pre-book shuttles during busy weekends.

transport.name: San Jose International Airport (SJC)
transport.notes: Team-confirmed itinerary: UA481 reaches SJC August 28 at 10:36 PM PDT after a 6:03 PM PDT / 8:03 PM CDT departure. Use United Flight Status for travel-day gate, delay, and arrival changes.

transport.name: Burney Falls Trailhead
transport.notes: The team sleeps near SJC on August 28 and drives north at about 5:00–5:30 AM on August 29, reaching this access point in the early afternoon. Confirm the drop-off and connector before arrival, and do not start hiking until the team is fed, hydrated, and current Burney access is checked.

transport.name: Bartle Gap Supported Transfer
transport.notes: August 31 exact PCT pickup and September 1 exact-point re-entry. This is not a campsite. Confirm high-clearance road access, gate status, driver, pickup window, pack transfer, staged water, and no-contact fallback.

transport.name: Ash Camp Pickup
transport.notes: September 5 primary pickup; September 6 contingency. FS Road 38N11 is rough and must be rechecked.
